messages:
Anika Patel: Quick heads-up — want to run a focused triage for the enablement gap we observed on Kestrel Health. Renewal signal dipped after last training and CS dashboard flagged churn indicators. Can we book a 45m deep-dive this week to align CS / AE / PS, capture remediation actions, and hand off renewal signals? Proposed agenda + two slot options below. Doodle: https://doodle.com/poll/enable-gap-kestrel or cal: https://cal.com/redwood/enab-gap-triage

Diego Rivera: +1. Passing to AE — I’ll confirm renewal flags. Prefer Thu 10:00-10:45 PT.

Sofia Chen: I can do Thu 10. Suggest adding a 10m role-play for the new prompt-routing docs so AEs can demo. Agenda tweak?

Liam O'Connor: Thu 10 also works for me. I’ll bring account health snapshots and token-usage trends. CS Bot auto-alert shows renewal-risk score=72 for kestrel (high) :eyes:.

Anika Patel: Updated agenda (compact):
```
1) Quick health snapshot (5m)
2) Gap walk-through & customer feedback (15m)
3) AE renewal signals + risk matrix (10m)
4) PS workaround + role-play (10m)
5) Actions, owners, and follow-ups (5m)
```
Please drop dashboards and last NPS quote before the meeting: https://redwood.app/dashboards/kestrel-health

Diego Rivera: Sounds good. AE will prep contract cadence and churn triggers. @Sofia can you draft the role-play script and 2 templates?

Sofia Chen: Yep — I’ll add 3 prompt templates and a short script to the enablement doc: https://docs.redwood.com/enables/kestrel-roleplay. Will tag examples for Dedicated vs Hosted cases.

Liam O'Connor: Suggest we include a quick snippet of recent customer comments. Pasting here: "We like the latency but need clearer docs for private deployment and model pinning." Might explain the drop in adoption.

Anika Patel: Great context. Action items recap before booking: Diego - confirm renewal tier and outreach cadence; Sofia - role-play + templates; Liam - dashboard snapshots + NPS quotes; Anika - run the session and compile the post-meeting playbook. If no objections, locking Thu 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Book link: https://cal.com/redwood/enab-gap-triage — I’ll send the invite and add a brief pre-read.

Diego Rivera: No objections. Adding AE stakeholder: @Maya Singh (cc).

Maya Singh: I’m in. Will bring commercial context, renewal levers, and contract cadence options.

CS Bot: Reminder — add this meeting to the account playbook and tag the ticket with `renewal-risk-high` if action items > 2.

Sofia Chen: 👍 saved the doc and added the role-play templates. Link updated.

Anika Patel: Thanks team — see you Thu. I’ll capture notes and publish a short playbook with owners and timelines after the meeting. :spiral_calendar_pad:
